slides.heading: Bst Traversal
slides.subtitle: AlgoExpert · Medium · Binary Search Trees
slides.narration: Let's solve Bst Traversal, a medium binary search trees problem. We'll restate the problem, build the intuition, walk through the approach, read the Java solution, and finish with its complexity.

slides.heading: The problem
bullets: In-order, pre-order and post-order traversals appending into a list.
slides.narration: Here's the problem. In-order, pre-order and post-order traversals appending into a list.

slides.heading: Intuition
bullets: In-order, pre-order and post-order differ only in when the node is visited relative to its children.
slides.narration: In-order, pre-order and post-order differ only in when the node is visited relative to its children.

slides.heading: Approach
slides.narration: Step by step. First, in-order: left, node, right. Second, pre-order: node, left, right. Third, post-order: left, right, node.

slides.heading: Java solution
slides.narration: Here's the Java solution, starting with in order traverse. It follows the steps we just described.

slides.heading: Complexity
slides.narration: Time is O of n. Space is O of n.

slides.heading: Recap
bullets: In-order, pre-order and post-order differ only in when the node is visited relative to its children.
